description: The same brief as a-package-is-a-table, with the sentence that case had first: Robin asks to start with how the PDF gets produced. That has two honest readings, which package writes it and where it is written, so either row may be the one asked. Whichever it is, the page carries the package table, the package row is open with no package proposed (the run has no network), and the ask is `Which option for <id>?` for either: the package table in the reply for the package row, three or four options with one recommended for any other, never a yes or no.
prompt: We are planning the architecture for the export feature. The brief is docs/export-brief.md. This is a planning session. Start with how the PDF gets produced: that is the first thing I want to decide.

graders.name: nothing new outside the plan dir and the architecture dir
nothing written is hard-wrapped or width-capped
the package decision is a table of packages
the table has the package and at least two alternatives
with no network, a fact says it was not read
with no network, every fact cell is not read or a dash
with no network, the package row is open, not proposed
the last line asks the row named as the next decision
the reply asks no yes or no
the reply lays the options out as a table
the reply offers three or four options, or the candidates, or says why fewer
with no network, a reply that asks the package row proposes and recommends no package
graders.pattern: (?sm)\A(?:(?!\|\s*Package\s*\|\s*Purpose here\s*\|).)*\Z|The options\.\W*No package is proposed.*^\W*Recommend:\W*no option\b

graders.name: the recommendation names an option or no option, never an order of settling
